facebook.long_form:
Kendall Wells is doing exactly what Kendall Wells does.

Last night at Love's Field, the NFCA Freshman of the Year hit another home run in Game 4 of Oklahoma's fall Battle Series. Just like she did all last spring — 39 times — Wells was the most electric player on the field.

Game 4 was another opportunity for fans to see the pieces of a potential 2027 championship come into focus. Haley Kavan, the two-time WCWS Most Outstanding Player, continues to anchor the program. Jocelyn Berzon has looked sharp in the circle. And Wells has been the story of every fall outing.

But there is one more game to look forward to before the wait for February begins.

Game 5 is tomorrow — Thursday, October 23 — at Love's Field against USAO. First pitch: 6:30 PM CT. Stream it free at 1oklahoma.com. One final fall look at the Sooners before the offseason.

Don't miss it. 🌪️

stories.title: 2028 Extra Elite 100 — Window Closes Today, Top-5 Reveal Oct 27

x_posts.label: Post 2
x_posts.text:
The 2028 Extra Elite 100 nomination window closes TODAY.

Top-5 reveal: Monday, Oct 27 — the most-watched moment in 2028 recruiting.

• 1,200+ players nominated
• Largest class ever evaluated

Who lands No. 1 overall? We'll know Monday. #Softball #Recruiting

facebook.long_form:
Today is the last day.

The 2028 Extra Elite 100 nomination window closes on October 22 — and the softball recruiting world is holding its breath. Extra Inning Softball has been releasing ranked tiers for weeks now, working from No. 100 all the way down to No. 6. More than 1,200 players were nominated this cycle, making the Class of 2028 the largest ever evaluated.

The big reveal — the Top 5 — drops this Monday, October 27.

Here's what we already know about the 2028 landscape: Florida's Kylie Holden is considered No. 2 overall by Softball America, and she's already committed to the Gators. Texas commit Michaela Landers is the consensus No. 1 infielder. OU holds a strong class anchored by Schlader. The teams with the best 2028 classes — Florida, Texas, and OU — are no coincidence: they're the same programs that have dominated recent WCWSs.

The next contact window opens October 24-25. Expect another wave of commits to follow that announcement.

Who do you think lands the No. 1 overall spot? 👇

stories.title: Oct 23 Fall Ball Triple-Feature — OU vs USAO + Florida vs UNF + Tennessee vs Lee

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
Three elite programs. Three fall games. One Thursday:

🔴 Oklahoma vs USAO — Love's Field, 6:30 PM CT
🟠 Florida vs UNF — Katie Seashole Pressly (free)
🍊 Tennessee vs Lee — Sherri Parker Lee (free, fall finale)

Best day of fall softball all season. #Softball #NCAA

facebook.long_form:
Three elite softball programs play tomorrow. Three games. One incredible Thursday.

Here is your complete guide to Fall Ball Thursday, October 23:

**Oklahoma vs USAO — Love's Field, Norman**
Time: 6:30 PM CT | Stream: 1oklahoma.com | Free

Battle Series Game 5 features Haley Kavan, Kendall Wells (39 HR as a freshman), and the full Sooners roster in their penultimate fall appearance. After this, the next scheduled fall game is October 30 vs Seminole State.

**Florida vs UNF — Katie Seashole Pressly Stadium, Gainesville**
Free admission

The Gators enter this one at 2-0 in fall ball after demolishing Santa Fe (20-0) and Carson-Newman (29-1) on consecutive days last week. Six starters return, and a loaded portal class joined an already-stacked program. Tim Walton's team looks like a national title contender for 2027.

**Tennessee vs Lee University — Sherri Parker Lee Stadium, Knoxville**
Free admission (Fall Finale)

The Lady Vols close their 2026 fall schedule at home. Karlyn Pickens (194 K, 1.70 ERA) and Sage Mardjetko (16-3, 1.26 ERA, NFCA All-American) get one final game to tune up before the offseason. It's a free goodbye to fall for Vol fans.

Three games. Zero ticket costs. Just pure softball. Set those DVRs.

stories.title: Texas Tech 2027 Roster Takes Shape — Pickering Headline Among Full Portal Class

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
Texas Tech's 2027 roster is set:

• Kasidi Pickering — .384 BA, 50 HR, 169 RBI at OU
• Portal class: Heavener, Polar, Gallaway
• Staff: Cottrill + Pendley

WCWS finalists last spring. Big 12 play starts March 12.

The Red Raiders are built to compete. #TexasTech #Softball

facebook.long_form:
Texas Tech's 2027 softball roster is assembled. And it looks like a WCWS contender.

The Red Raiders entered the offseason as WCWS finalists. Head coach Jeff Cottrill — who arrived from Houston — made immediate moves in the transfer portal to rebuild around a veteran core. The result is a roster that looks ready to compete from day one of the 2027 campaign.

**The Portal Class:**
Kasidi Pickering headlines the group. In three seasons at Oklahoma, she hit .384 with 50 home runs and 169 RBI — numbers that put her in elite company among the best hitters in modern college softball. She signed with the Red Raiders on June 19.

She's joined by Heavener (a top portal bat), Polar, and Gallaway — giving Cottrill four experienced additions alongside a strong returning core. Alex Williams hit 27 home runs last season (program record) and returns along with first-team All-American Terry.

**The Coaching Staff:**
Shelby Pendley brings a resume that speaks for itself. As a shortstop at Oklahoma, she put up 84 home runs and 269 RBI in her career — among the best ever by a Sooner. She transitioned to coaching at New Mexico, Jackson State, and Belhaven before joining Cottrill's staff.

Big 12 play begins March 12. Circle it. The Red Raiders are for real.

stories.title: Tennessee Fall Finale Tomorrow — Pickens and Mardjetko Wrap a Dominant Autumn

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text:
Tennessee's 2026 fall finale is tomorrow — free at Sherri Parker Lee Stadium vs Lee University.

The Vols close out a fall featuring:

• Karlyn Pickens — 194 K, 1.70 ERA
• Sage Mardjetko — 16-3, 1.26 ERA

The 2027 Lady Vols will be special. #Tennessee #GBO #Softball

facebook.long_form:
Tomorrow is the last day of fall ball for Tennessee softball.

The Lady Vols host Lee University at Sherri Parker Lee Stadium on Thursday, October 23 — free admission, as all Tennessee fall home games have been. It's the program's final competitive look before the long winter offseason begins and preparations for the 2027 season accelerate in earnest.

What a fall it has been.

Karlyn Pickens — the No. 1 pick in the 2026 AUSL Draft who elected to return for a fifth year — has been dominant. Her 194 strikeouts and 1.70 ERA last spring made her arguably the best pitcher in the country, and nothing in the fall has changed that assessment.

Sage Mardjetko went 16-3 with a 1.26 ERA and earned NFCA All-American honors last spring. She and Pickens together give Tennessee a pitching depth that Karen Weekly called "the best in program history."

Add Ehren Earleywine as associate head coach and hitting coach — he came from the 2026 national champion Texas staff — and you have a program that has quietly rebuilt its staff without missing a beat.

The fall finale is tomorrow. Be there. 🍊
